title: Pin restored-wake Resume command identity and post-handoff evidence in the shutdown regression
outcome: Harden the restored-carrier Resume control against future stray or duplicate sends by checking the exact delivered prompt identity and retained post-handoff evidence.
acceptance: The restored-carrier regression checks delivered command text/source against the original wake and verifies the retained receipt uses a fresh handoff nonce/current turn with unknown journal effect after the controlled channel enqueue.

The assertions keep the automatic unpaused-recovery and explicitly paused Resume scenarios distinct, use no timeout inflation or provider OS-ACK claim, and do not weaken the existing exact-hold/reload checks.
